H3935.name: Laadah
H3935.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3935.short: Laadah, a son of Shelah and descendant of Judah.

H3936G.name: Ladan
H3936G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

H3902.name: Lahmi
H3902.desc: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
H3902.short: Lahmi, the brother of Goliath, was killed by Elhanan the Bethlehemite.

H3929G.name: Lamech
H3929G.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H3929G.brief: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible
H3929G.short: Lamech, a descendant of Cain, was the first polygamist mentioned in the Bible.

H3929H.name: Lamech
H3929H.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H3929H.short: Lamech, the father of Noah, lived 777 years.

H3941.name: Lappidoth
H3941.brief: Husband of Deborah the prophetess and judge
H3941.short: Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah, a prophetess and judge in Israel.

H3922.name: Lecah
H3922.desc: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3922.short: Lecah, a descendant of Judah through Er.

H3927.name: Lemuel
H3927.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H3927.brief: King mentioned in Proverbs; his mother taught him wisdom
H3927.short: Lemuel, a king whose wise sayings are recorded in Proverbs 31, as taught by his mother.

H3912.name: Letushim
H3912.brief: Son of Dedan, descendant of Abraham and Keturah
H3912.short: Letushim, a son of Dedan and descendant of Abraham and Keturah.

H3949.name: Likhi
H3949.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3949.short: Likhi, a son of Shemida and descendant of Manasseh.

H3923.name: Lachish
H3923.short: Lachish, a fortified city in Judah, captured by Joshua and later by the Assyrians (<ref="Joshua 10; 2Ki.18.14, 19:8">Joshua 10; 2Ki.18.14, 19:8</ref>).

H3903.name: Lahmam
H3903.brief: A city in the lowlands of Judah
H3903.short: Lahmam, a city in the lowlands of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:40">Joshua 15:40</ref>).

H3919C.name: Laishah
H3919C.brief: A place near Anathoth and Gallim
H3919C.short: Laishah, a place near Anathoth and Gallim, mentioned in a prophecy of Isaiah (<ref="Isaiah 10:30">Isaiah 10:30</ref>).

H3946.name: Lakkum
H3946.short: Lakkum, a border town of the tribe of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 19:33">Joshua 19:33</ref>).

H3962.name: Lasha
H3962.brief: A place marking Canaanite territory; a stop in Israel's journey
H3962.short: Lasha (Nahaliel), a place marking the extent of Canaanite territory (<ref="Genesis 10:19">Genesis 10:19</ref>) and a stop in Israel's wilderness journey (<ref="Numbers 21:19">Numbers 21:19</ref>).
